slots.title: Outrun the Cut
slots.brief: Helios is closing the belt for a demolition sweep. Cross the start marker to open your escape window. Each safe gate extends it; stopping too long closes the route.
slots.summary: Belt escape. Clear each gate before the escape margin runs out. The clock starts at the first gate.

adventureSpeed.failureText: The demolition exclusion window caught your route. Return to Helios for another run.

params.adventureSpeedHint: Reach the start marker. The pressure clock begins when you cross it.
params.terrain: Helios starter belt and the outer metallic field
params.gridLine: Fly to the start marker. Crossing it begins the timed passage.

slots.title: The Cold Chain
slots.brief: Carry eight sealed medical packs through the belt. Radiation arrives from the west: shelter on the east side of rocks, wrecks or stations to cool the load. Boost and travel burn heat it faster. Heat above 75 damages quality and spoils real packs; deliver what survives before the corridor closes.
slots.summary: Medical delivery. Trade a fast exposed burn for cooling behind solid cover; temperature and pack quality are shown in flight.

adventureSpeed.failureText: The medical corridor closed. The sealed load has been recalled; Helios can issue a fresh delivery.

params.adventureSpeedHint: Eight sealed medical packs aboard. Reach the start; east sides of solid cover cool the load.
